name: facebookresearch_isdf/isdf/eval/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_isdf/isdf/eval/eval_pts.run_fixed_pts_eval: run fixed_pts_eval to compute SDF and gradient metrics on fixed evaluation points for a given timestep
facebookresearch_isdf/isdf/eval/eval_pts.run_sub_eval: run sub_eval to compute L1 SDF error, binned losses, and chomp cost differences between predicted and ground truth SDF values
facebookresearch_isdf/isdf/eval/eval_pts.run_eval_grad: run eval_grad to compute numerical gradients of an SDF interpolation at given points using finite differences

facebookresearch_isdf/isdf/eval/metrics..calculate_completion_ratio: calculate the completion ratio between ground truth and reconstructed point clouds using a distance threshold
facebookresearch_isdf/isdf/eval/metrics..compute_chomp_collision_cost: compute the CHOMP collision cost from signed distance field samples along a trajectory
facebookresearch_isdf/isdf/eval/metrics..compute_aligned_ate: compute the aligned absolute trajectory error RMSE between two sets of poses
facebookresearch_isdf/isdf/eval/metrics..bin_sdf_losses: bin signed distance field prediction losses into distance-based bins for analysis

facebookresearch_isdf/isdf/eval/plot_uti.load_res: load and return the JSON results file from an experiment directory
facebookresearch_isdf/isdf/eval/plot_uti.load_gt_sdf: load a ground truth signed distance field grid and create an interpolator from directory files
facebookresearch_isdf/isdf/eval/plot_uti.get_gpuf_sdf_interp: get a signed distance field interpolator from GpuFusion experiment output at a given evaluation time
facebookresearch_isdf/isdf/eval/plot_uti.get_voxblox_sdf_interp: get a signed distance field interpolator from VoxBloX experiment output using a ground truth mesh
